approach.name: Gallery
approach.description: Image-led, few words; collections as big tiles.

pages.label: Announcement bar
pages.approach: Image-led, few words; collections as big tiles.

sections.label: Store promises
sections.intent: A short run of the store's own messages (free delivery threshold, easy returns, a current offer code) so every kind of shop can share its promise in a few warm words without crowding the page
sections.layout: a slow edge-to-edge marquee on a thin frosted strip, messages separated by small icons

pages.label: Header
pages.approach: Image-led, few words; collections as big tiles.

sections.label: Top bar
sections.intent: Logo, menu, search, account and cart in one frosted bar that floats over the soft colour behind it, so the pictures underneath stay visible; it suits any catalogue from groceries to auto parts
sections.layout: logo left, menu centred, icons right; on phones a compact bar with the menu in a drawer and search as an icon

pages.label: Home
pages.approach: Image-led, few words; collections as big tiles.

sections.label: Opening picture
sections.intent: One big campaign picture the store swaps in, with a single bold line and two calls to action (shop new, see offers). It leads with the image so it works for any category
sections.layout: full-bleed campaign picture with a centred frosted card floating over it; without one, the card beside a framed photo

sections.label: Shop by category
sections.intent: The store's main categories as large picture tiles with only their names, so shoppers jump straight in whatever the store sells
sections.layout: a picture mosaic (layout="mosaic") with one large lead tile, fitting any number of categories

sections.label: Brands we carry
sections.intent: Brand logos in steady motion to show range and trust at a glance
sections.layout: edge-to-edge marquee strip on a tinted glass band

sections.label: New this week
sections.intent: Fresh arrivals shown big, with picture, price and quick add, so the store feels alive and updated
sections.layout: product cards that overlap slightly, offset up and down along a row

sections.label: Offers on now
sections.intent: The current sale or code with a countdown, for mid-price shoppers who watch for good deals
sections.layout: band in the brand colour with light text, countdown centred, a short link at the end

sections.label: Featured collection
sections.intent: One collection the owner picks, shown as a large picture beside a few of its products, so the home page has a clear focus
sections.layout: two columns: large picture on the left, a short line and three product cards on the right

sections.label: Shoppers say
sections.intent: Short, real reviews with star ratings that show buyers from across India trust the store
sections.layout: a heading pinned on the left beside a scrolling list of review cards

sections.label: Stay in touch
sections.intent: A quiet invite to get offers and new arrivals by email, in one warm line
sections.layout: centred narrow column with generous space on a frosted panel

pages.label: Product listing
pages.approach: Image-led, few words; collections as big tiles.

sections.label: All products
sections.intent: A light title for the full catalogue with breadcrumbs, result count and category chips so shoppers can narrow down quickly
sections.layout: slim band under a thin rule, chips scrolling sideways below the title

sections.label: Browse and filter
sections.intent: Every product as picture-led cards with filters and sort, so any kind of catalogue stays easy to scan
sections.layout: filters in a frosted column on the left, a wide image grid on the right, sort above the grid

pages.label: Category pages
pages.approach: Image-led, few words; collections as big tiles.

sections.label: Category opening
sections.intent: Breadcrumbs, the name from <Category> as the heading, its tagline and description on a glass panel over its hero picture, and its <SubCategories> as chips that hide when there are none
sections.layout: full-width band with the words over the picture inside a frosted card set to the left

sections.label: Products in this category
sections.intent: The products in <Category> in a clean picture grid, with result count and sort on top and filters in a drawer so the images stay large
sections.layout: a slim toolbar over a four-column grid, filters slide in from the side

sections.label: Questions and more
sections.intent: The <CategoryFaqs> beside the longer <SeoText>, quiet and easy to read, each hiding when empty
sections.layout: two columns: accordion on the left, text on the right, on a soft tinted background

pages.label: Brand pages
pages.approach: Image-led, few words; collections as big tiles.

sections.label: Meet the brand
sections.intent: Breadcrumbs, the logo and name from <Brand>, its tagline and a short introduction with website and social links, so shoppers know who makes what they buy
sections.layout: logo on a frosted card on one side, words on the other, over the brand banner when it has one

sections.label: Brand products
sections.intent: Everything from <Brand> with filters and sort to find the right item fast
sections.layout: filters in a column on the left, the grid on the right with count and sort above

sections.label: Brand story
sections.intent: The longer story from <Brand> and its <SeoText>, each hiding when empty, for shoppers who want to know more
sections.layout: centred narrow column with generous space

pages.label: Search results
pages.approach: Image-led, few words; collections as big tiles.

sections.label: Your search
sections.intent: The term and result count from <SearchQuery> with the search box to try again, then filters beside the matching products
sections.layout: slim frosted band on top, filters in a left column and the results grid on the right below

sections.label: Try a category
sections.intent: The store's categories as picture tiles for shoppers who did not find what they wanted
sections.layout: centred heading over a horizontal scroller of picture tiles

pages.label: Product page
pages.approach: Image-led, few words; collections as big tiles.

sections.label: Product and buying
sections.intent: Large gallery beside a glass buy box: title, rating, price with discount, options, quantity, add to cart, buy now, wishlist and a pincode delivery check that matters for shoppers across India
sections.layout: gallery on the left, sticky frosted buy box on the right

sections.label: Details and specs
sections.intent: Description and specifications in tabs, which fit anything from a kurta to a phone charger
sections.layout: centred narrow column with tabs across the top

sections.label: What buyers say
sections.intent: Ratings and reviews from people who bought this item
sections.layout: heading and average stars pinned on the left beside the list of reviews

sections.label: You may also like
sections.intent: Related products to keep browsing visually
sections.layout: full-width tinted band with a centred heading over a card carousel

pages.label: Cart
pages.approach: Image-led, few words; collections as big tiles.

sections.label: Free delivery meter
sections.intent: How much more to add for free delivery, a gentle nudge for mid-price baskets
sections.layout: slim full-width frosted band

sections.label: Your bag
sections.intent: Cart lines beside the summary, coupon box, trust badges and checkout; a friendly empty state when the bag is empty
sections.layout: lines on the left, a sticky glass summary card on the right

sections.label: Add before you go
sections.intent: A few small add-ons that pair with the bag
sections.layout: horizontal scroller of cards

pages.label: Checkout
pages.approach: Image-led, few words; collections as big tiles.

sections.label: Checkout steps
sections.intent: Contact, address, delivery choice and payment in clear steps beside the order summary with coupon
sections.layout: form steps on the left, sticky order summary right; summary first on phones

sections.label: Safe and supported
sections.intent: Secure payment, easy returns and help contact, to calm last-minute doubts
sections.layout: quiet centred band with three columns

pages.label: About
pages.approach: Image-led, few words; collections as big tiles.

sections.label: Who we are
sections.intent: The store's opening statement in one warm line over its own big picture
sections.layout: full-bleed picture with a frosted panel of words in the lower left

sections.label: Our story
sections.intent: How the store began and who it serves, in a few short paragraphs and pictures
sections.layout: two columns: picture on one side, words on the other

sections.label: What we promise
sections.intent: Three promises such as fair prices, careful packing and quick help, each with an icon
sections.layout: three cards that overlap slightly, offset up and down

sections.label: Shoppers say
sections.intent: Reviews from real customers to back the story
sections.layout: band in the brand colour with light text and a slow review carousel

sections.label: Start shopping
sections.intent: A simple invite back to the categories
sections.layout: centred card floating over a tinted background

pages.label: Contact
pages.approach: Image-led, few words; collections as big tiles.

sections.label: Reach us
sections.intent: Phone, email, WhatsApp, address and hours, the way Indian shoppers like to get in touch
sections.layout: heading pinned on the left beside the list of contact ways on glass cards

sections.label: Common questions
sections.intent: Delivery, returns, payment and order tracking answers, so many shoppers need not write in
sections.layout: centred narrow column with an accordion

sections.label: Talk to us
sections.intent: A warm band inviting a call or WhatsApp message
sections.layout: band in the brand colour with light text and two links

pages.label: All categories
pages.approach: Image-led, few words; collections as big tiles.

sections.label: Every category
sections.intent: Every category from <AllCategories> as picture tiles with subcategories and product counts, under breadcrumbs and a big heading
sections.layout: centred heading over a mosaic with one large tile

sections.label: Browse everything
sections.intent: A closing invite to see all products at once
sections.layout: band in the brand colour with light text

pages.label: All brands
pages.approach: Image-led, few words; collections as big tiles.

sections.label: All our brands
sections.intent: Every brand from <AllBrands> as frosted logo cards with taglines and product counts, under breadcrumbs
sections.layout: slim title band over a wide grid

sections.label: Browse everything
sections.intent: A gentle invite to see every product
sections.layout: centred card floating over a tinted background

pages.label: Footer
pages.approach: Image-led, few words; collections as big tiles.

sections.label: Footer
sections.intent: The store line and logo with link columns for shop, help and policies, plus social links
sections.layout: large brand line on a frosted panel beside the link columns, slim bottom bar

pages.label: Sign in
pages.approach: Image-led, few words; collections as big tiles.

sections.label: Sign-in split
sections.intent: Sign-in split: a brand panel in the store colours with a warm welcome back and two or three short reasons to sign in (orders and returns in one place, saved addresses for a quicker checkout) beside <SignInForm />
sections.layout: on a softly tinted surface with generous space

sections.label: Reassurance strip
sections.intent: Reassurance strip: a secure sign-in with a one-time code, orders and returns in one place, saved addresses, as three short notes with icons
sections.layout: on a softly tinted surface with generous space

pages.label: Sign up
pages.approach: Image-led, few words; collections as big tiles.

sections.label: Join split
sections.intent: Join split: a brand panel with the reasons to create an account (every order in one place, saved addresses, a quicker checkout, a wishlist) beside <SignUpForm />
sections.layout: type-led, with one accent colour

sections.label: What an account gives
sections.intent: What an account gives: orders in one place, saved addresses, a wishlist, as three short notes with icons
sections.layout: type-led, with one accent colour

pages.label: Account pages
pages.approach: Image-led, few words; collections as big tiles.

sections.label: Account frame
sections.intent: Account frame: a quiet heading strip with a short line about the shopper’s corner of the store, then <AccountPage /> full width
sections.layout: calm, with generous side space

sections.label: Help band
sections.intent: Help band: where to get help with an order, returns and the policies, as a few quiet links (/support, /return-policy, /legal)
sections.layout: calm, with generous side space

pages.label: Order details
pages.approach: Image-led, few words; collections as big tiles.

sections.label: Order page
sections.intent: Order page: a slim band with a link back to all orders (/account/orders), then <OrderDetail /> full width
sections.layout: on a softly tinted surface

sections.label: Help with this order
sections.intent: Help with this order: contact options from <Store> and links to returns (/return-policy) and support (/support)
sections.layout: calm, with generous side space

pages.label: Wishlist
pages.approach: Image-led, few words; collections as big tiles.

sections.label: Wishlist
sections.intent: Wishlist: a heading band in the store voice for saved favourites (the page’s h1), then <WishlistGrid /> full width
sections.layout: quiet, with thin rules between the parts

sections.label: More to love
sections.intent: More to love: best sellers from <Products> as the site’s product cards, under a short heading
sections.layout: type-led, with one accent colour

pages.label: Compare
pages.approach: Image-led, few words; collections as big tiles.

sections.label: Compare
sections.intent: Compare: a quiet title strip with the h1, then <CompareTable /> full width
sections.layout: on a softly tinted surface

sections.label: Help choosing
sections.intent: Help choosing: a quiet band pointing to support (/support) and contact options from <Store>
sections.layout: on a softly tinted surface

pages.label: Policies
pages.approach: Image-led, few words; collections as big tiles.

sections.label: Policies
sections.intent: Policies: <LegalContent /> full width on a calm surface under a thin rule
sections.layout: on a softly tinted surface

sections.label: Questions
sections.intent: Questions: a quiet band pointing to support (/support) and contact options from <Store>
sections.layout: type-led, with one accent colour

pages.label: Returns
pages.approach: Image-led, few words; collections as big tiles.

sections.label: Returns
sections.intent: Returns: a clear heading band (the page’s h1) with a short reassuring line that makes no promise, then <ReturnsContent /> full width
sections.layout: type-led, with one accent colour

sections.label: Still need help
sections.intent: Still need help: contact options from <Store> and a link to support (/support)
sections.layout: on a softly tinted surface

pages.label: Help and support
pages.approach: Image-led, few words; collections as big tiles.

sections.label: Help centre
sections.intent: Help centre: a tinted band with the h1 and a short line, then <SupportContent /> full width
sections.layout: on a softly tinted surface

sections.label: Call or message
sections.intent: Call or message: a closing band inviting a call or a WhatsApp message through <Store>
sections.layout: on a softly tinted surface

pages.label: Page not found
pages.approach: Image-led, few words; collections as big tiles.

sections.label: Lost page
sections.intent: Lost page: an oversized 404 in the store’s type and a friendly line in the store voice (the h1), with <NotFoundContent /> under it
sections.layout: type-led, with one oversized accent

sections.label: New in
sections.intent: New in: the newest products from <Products> as the site’s product cards, under a short heading
sections.layout: centred, with generous space
